name: Speedster Radical SSR frameset
claimed_frame_weight_basis: Size 54, unpainted, excluding paint and metal hardware

editorial.verdict: The SSR is Incolor's current radical-aero flagship: a 750 g size-54 claim, integrated seat mast, seven-size geometry and 36C 1× envelope, now tied to a current CNY 23,800 official-store listing.
best_for: buyers who can fit and maintain an integrated seat mast
strengths: Seven-size official standard geometry plus manufacturer custom-fit options
Official mainland store and lifetime carbon frame/fork warranty route
caveats: The integrated seat mast reduces fit and travel flexibility
The 750 g claim excludes paint and metal hardware
Manufacturer aero and stiffness explanations lack an independent published protocol
Independent long-term quality-control and crash-replacement evidence remains limited

purchase_route: Official INCOLOR Taobao listing or a mainland dealer listed by the manufacturer
